parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the security group. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length. It must start with a letter and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: Permissions
parameters.description: The rules of the security group. Valid values of N: 0 to 200.

sub_parameters.name: Description
sub_parameters.description: The description of the security group rule. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

sub_parameters.name: DestCidrIp
sub_parameters.description: The destination IPv4 CIDR block. CIDR blocks and IPv4 addresses are supported.

sub_parameters.name: Direction
sub_parameters.description:
The direction of the security group rule. Valid values:

- egress: outbound

- ingress: inbound

sub_parameters.name: IpProtocol
sub_parameters.description:
The transport layer protocol. Valid values:

- TCP

- UDP

- ICMP

- ALL

sub_parameters.name: Policy
sub_parameters.description:
The policy of the security group rule. Valid values:

- Accept: allows access.

- Drop: denies access.

sub_parameters.name: PortRange
sub_parameters.description:
The range of the destination ports for the security group rule. Valid values:

- If you set the IpProtocol to TCP or UDP, the port range is 1 to 65535. You must use a forward slash (/) to separate the start port and the end port, for example, 1/200.

- If you set the IpProtocol to ICMP, the port range is -1/-1.

- If you set the IpProtocol to ALL, the port range is -1/-1.

sub_parameters.name: Priority
sub_parameters.description: The priority of the security group rule. A smaller value indicates a higher priority. Valid values: 1 to 100.

sub_parameters.name: SourceCidrIp
sub_parameters.description: The source IPv4 CIDR block. CIDR blocks and IPv4 addresses are supported.

sub_parameters.name: SourcePortRange
sub_parameters.description:
The range of the source ports for the security group rule. Valid values:

- If you set the IpProtocol to TCP or UDP, the port range is 1 to 65535. You must use a forward slash (/) to separate the start port and the end port, for example, 1/200.

- If you set the IpProtocol to ICMP, the port range is -1/-1.

- If you set the IpProtocol to ALL, the port range is -1/-1.

parameters.name: SecurityGroupName
parameters.description: The name of the security group. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length, and can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. By default, this parameter is empty.
